title: Travis Walton case fire-tower debunk disputed

tellings.quote: And there and they talk about this fire tower and it's like it was right next to the road. It's like, no, it's not. It's over a hill.

plain: In 1975 in Arizona, a man named Travis Walton became the centre of a well-known story about an encounter with something unexplained, and some people have tried to explain it away by pointing to a nearby fire tower, a lookout used to spot forest fires. A researcher named Greg Bishop, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says that this explanation gets the place wrong: it claims the tower was right next to the road, but he says it is actually over a hill. If he is right, that ordinary explanation of the case would be weaker.
